summary: Full E2E of the new 'Laboratorio Smart e Pesata Guidata' module (3 phases). Backend: 15 pytest cases (auth gating, dough-sessions CRUD, deterministic Day-After too_warm/too_cold/on_target/no-history, Claude AI advice, HACCP CRUD, validation) — all passed. Frontend: Phase 1 GuidedWeighing full run (setup -> run -> summary -> reset) with real hydration 67.7% and food cost EUR 1.84 correctly computed from actual weights, deviation shown in gw-extras; Phase 2 DoughLog save -> Day-After panel (verdict 'Troppo caldo +2.5C', suggested water 13C) -> Claude advice (692 chars) -> history + delete; Phase 3 HACCP manual entry -> list -> delete, scan button degrades gracefully in headless. Regression: bilancia, meteo, market, lotti all open with zero console errors. All test data cleaned (dough_sessions and haccp_logs collections empty).

issues: Floating 'Radio' and 'Parla' FABs sit above page content near the bottom and overlap list rows / the Giorno Dopo panel; they can obstruct taps on the last visible row (all tested clicks still worked, but consider extra bottom padding or hiding FABs inside tools)

Cosmetic: separator dots render empty segments when optional fields are missing, e.g. '8001234567890 · lotto TEST_LOT9 · · 4.5°C' (HaccpLog.jsx line 147 — join non-empty parts instead of concatenating ' · ')

action_items: Optional: fix double '·' separator in HaccpLog list row when expiry/supplier empty
Optional: avoid Radio/Parla FAB overlap with bottom list content in tool views
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2719 lines — well over the 700-line guideline; consider splitting the new lab-smart routers (dough sessions / HACCP) into separate modules.

GuidedWeighing run view: gw-next is disabled for both 'under' and 'over' states, so a real over-pour cannot be logged/advanced without lowering the weight — deviations can only be recorded in the 95-99% band. Consider allowing 'confirm anyway' for over-pours.

DoughLog dayAfter refresh only depends on form.recipe_name (useEffect dep), so changing room temp/humidity does not re-run the day-after suggestion until save or name change — the suggested water can therefore be stale relative to today's inputs shown in the form.
